notes: GraphTM = Coalesced (shared clause pool, per-class weights) convolutional TM over hypervector-encoded graphs; all GraphTM clause counts are therefore stored with scope 'total'. Message-passing depth per setting: toy 2, disconnected images 1, superpixels 35, sentiment 1/2, Tangram 6/12, Amazon not stated, MovieLens 1, viral 1/2, XOR 2. Implementation is the authors' custom CUDA-kernel GraphTM (Sec. 3 'GPU Implementation Details'); library name and code link not given. No paper result states run count, seeds or what the +/- is; the only run count is Fig. 8 (five trials, multivalue noisy XOR, curves only, no record results). Table 22 (XOR): clauses {4,50,200,1000,2000}, T = 10 x clauses, s = 2.2, 500 symbols, HV 2048, message HV {2048,4096,8196 (text/Fig. 8 says 8192)}, depth 2, 1% noise. MNIST Superpixel: PDF internally inconsistent (Table 4 '2000 clauses', 88.09+/-0.27 vs text 89.24+/-1.34 and Table 17 60,000 clauses); record already notes this. Table 9 split not labelled, but its 5-class/2,000-clause cell equals Table 8 testing accuracy, so it is test accuracy. App. A.3 'another experiment' (3-class A/AA/AAA, 3 layers, 4 clauses) has no accuracy. No validation set mentioned anywhere.
